name: systemd-unit
description: Converge a systemd unit (service or timer) on the host running apply — user scope (~/.config/systemd/user, linger ensured) or system scope (/etc/systemd/system via sudo)
instructions: Host-converging module: apply runs on the machine the unit should live on. scope=user needs loginctl lingering (apply ensures it); scope=system needs passwordless sudo for systemctl and writes to /etc/systemd/system. Restarts the unit when content changes.
